title: Freedom of Movement
explanation: Citizens have the right to move freely throughout the territory of India.

title: Wrongful Restraint
explanation: Voluntarily obstructing any person from proceeding in any direction they have a right to proceed.

title: Arrest Conditions
explanation: Police cannot arrest without a warrant for certain offenses unless specific conditions are met.

title: Protection of Life and Liberty
explanation: No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.

title: Right Against Self-Incrimination
explanation: No accused person shall be compelled to be a witness against themselves.

title: Criminal Intimidation
explanation: Whoever threatens another with injury to their person, reputation, or property.
